mapper.select: SELECT h.api_url AS apiUrl, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.call_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.call_status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount, AVG(h.call_delay) AS avgCost FROM one_api_call_history h LEFT JOIN one_api_info i ON i.api_url = h.api_url WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.call_time >= #{startTime} AND h.call_time <= #{endTime} AND i.datasource_id = #{datasourceId} GROUP BY h.api_url
SELECT call_delay FROM one_api_call_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND api_url = #{apiUrl} AND call_time >= #{startTime} AND call_time <= #{endTime} AND call_delay IS NOT NULL ORDER BY call_delay ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.call_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.call_status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount, AVG(h.call_delay) AS avgCost FROM one_api_call_history h LEFT JOIN one_api_info i ON i.api_url = h.api_url WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.call_time >= #{startTime} AND h.call_time <= #{endTime} AND i.datasource_id = #{datasourceId}

SELECT h.api_url AS apiUrl, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.call_status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount FROM one_api_call_history h LEFT JOIN one_api_info i ON i.api_url = h.api_url WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.call_time >= #{startTime} AND h.call_time <= #{endTime} AND i.datasource_id = #{datasourceId} GROUP BY h.api_url ORDER BY callCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(call_time, #{dateFormat}) AS time, COUNT(*) AS callCount, AVG(call_delay) AS avgCost, SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount FROM one_api_call_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND call_time >= #{startTime} AND call_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(call_time, #{dateFormat}) ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT h.history_id AS callId, i.api_name AS apiName, i.req_method AS reqMethod, h.call_status AS status, h.call_delay AS costTime, h.call_ip AS caller, h.call_time AS callTime FROM one_api_call_history h LEFT JOIN one_api_info i ON i.api_url = h.api_url WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.call_time >= #{startTime} AND h.call_time <= #{endTime} AND h.api_url = #{apiUrl} AND h.call_status = #{callStatus} ORDER BY h.call_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
